item.title: Two sisters, 7 and 5, killed in La Gonâve, Haiti; police make arrests
item.description: Two young sisters were found dead in Kafoudèl, La Gonâve, after unknown individuals reportedly entered their home. Police have announced arrests, but authorities have not clarified whether the children were killed during a burglary or abducted and murdered elsewhere.
